name: progress
title: Progress and Meter
description: Native <progress> for task progress and <meter> for a measurement within a known range, each with a visible label and value.

aria: Value is also written as text so it is not color-only
Meter regions (low, high) are described by the visible text, not by color
a11y.notes: For streaming progress, announce changes in a separate throttled live region (at most every 2 s), never on the progress element itself.
